title: Korg MS-10 / MS-20 Filter Analysis
summary: In-depth analysis of the early (KORG35) and late (LM13600 OTA) MS-20 filters: the Sallen-Key topology, transistors in reverse saturation used as current-controlled resistors, the exponential cutoff control and the diode-limited resonance loop that gives the filter its aggressive character.

sources.title: A Study of the Korg MS10 & MS20 Filters
sources.author: Timothy E. Stinchcombe
sources.note: Mathematical analysis of both filter generations, including the KORG35 chip internals.

sources.title: Synth schematics: MS 20 Filter
sources.author: René Schmitz
sources.note: Reference DIY schematic of the late MS-20 filter with op-amp buffers and a CA3080/LM13700.

sources.title: ECE4450 L26: Sallen-Key Filters & the Korg MS-20 VCF
sources.author: Aaron Lanterman (Georgia Tech)
